assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and PROV-KEY-001 through PROV-KEY-003 are provisional rough intake geometry, not official redlines or parcel boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-dependent locations, areas and ratios are suitable only for concept discussion and package testing.
assumptions.next_action: Replace with organizer-issued official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons, then recut every dependent layer and recompute all metrics in EPSG:4548.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, land-use approval, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, setbacks, retain-renovate-demolish decisions, road works, utility capacity and construction feasibility remain unknown.
assumptions.next_action: Obtain official attachments and complete planning, tenure, engineering, fire, traffic and municipal professional review before statutory or implementation use.

assumptions.statement: Submitted building, green-space, public-space, road and phasing layers are authored concept prototypes rather than surveyed existing conditions.
assumptions.impact: Their areas, relations and feature counts cannot be presented as existing assets, approved projects or implementation quantities.
assumptions.next_action: Use cleared survey/official data and field verification to rebuild existing-condition layers before detailed design.

assumptions.statement: The proposed heritage-continuity relationship and six cross-links express interfaces to investigate. The legacy breathing-rail label is only a blue-green/environment-sensing module; none of these lines is a verified route, road centerline, bridge, tunnel or station work.
assumptions.impact: Route length, travel time, accessibility and engineering feasibility cannot be claimed from the current scaffold linework.
assumptions.next_action: Audit existing paths, crossings, gradients, closures and accessibility with official transport data and field checks; retain non-digital detour information.

assumptions.statement: Railway heritage, station, park, ownership and protection interfaces require item-level cultural-heritage and railway-authority confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Concept landmarks and removable components cannot be treated as approved installation locations or heritage interventions.
assumptions.next_action: Complete heritage inventory, rights check and railway/park operator review before locating or designing physical components.

assumptions.statement: No site-specific regulatory-grade air-quality baseline, approved monitoring scope, airflow study or health study has been supplied.
assumptions.impact: The proposal cannot claim current pollution conditions, clean-air outcomes, low-exposure guarantees, ventilation performance or medical benefit.
assumptions.next_action: Define the question with environmental professionals, obtain authorized reference data and keep all public outputs non-medical with timestamp, uncertainty and human review.

assumptions.statement: No sensor vendor, device, reference monitor, siting plan, collocation period, test protocol, power/network design or maintenance contract has been selected.
assumptions.impact: Sensor accuracy, coverage, uptime, calibration and operating cost remain unknown; no procurement or deployment claim is made.
assumptions.next_action: If a pilot is authorized, use a vendor-neutral requirement, cleared data agreement, reference collocation, documented QA/QC, cyber review, maintenance owner and stop threshold.

assumptions.statement: Named zones describe role hypotheses; no government agency, university, business, property owner, community organization or operator has accepted responsibility or funding.
assumptions.impact: Activities, services, resident programs, trials, landmarks and annual events remain recommendations rather than commitments.
assumptions.next_action: Confirm role-based RACI, consent, cost class, service hours, complaint handling, manual fallback, maintenance and sunset responsibility before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: The current package specifies AI scenario governance but does not yet contain a reproducible planning baseline, algorithm run, ablation, error analysis or multi-option evaluation.
assumptions.impact: AI-planning innovation remains a design hypothesis and must not be described as validated performance.
assumptions.next_action: Define one data-sufficient planning question, run the smallest reusable baseline and candidate comparison, record versions/seed/error/sensitivity, and retain professional and public human selection.

assumptions.statement: Public scenarios are designed without face recognition, plate recognition, personal movement traces, health profiles or compulsory account creation.
assumptions.impact: Any later service that requires personal or sensitive data falls outside this concept and triggers a new legal, ethical and security review.
assumptions.next_action: Use public, cleared, aggregate or synthetic data by default; document purpose, minimization, retention, access, withdrawal and human alternatives before adding any personal data.
